scores.tell: Bird feeder: orange roof and tree trunk are close in hue, so the card is warm-heavy. Greens and blues are natural and chroma is moderate. Slight sameness of orange.
Purple background with golden rope matches real hue pairing. Rope is a bit uniform yellow-orange and the shadows are muted, but it reads close.
Many hue families at once: red, blue, green, orange, yellow, brown. Background green and shelf orange compete, and the teddy and target are equally loud. Real cards are more restrained.
Teal stripes against navy telescope and orange wood make a good complementary pair. Wood floor and tripod are the same orange, so the warm share is slightly high.
Gold star on purple rays is a classic real-card hue pairing. The red gem is a small accent. Gold is a little saturated and has little shadow color.
Navy calculator with cyan keys on a yellow-orange pi pattern. The hue roles are clear and the colors are clean. The tell is that the pure cyan keys look slightly synthetic.

The turquoise water and sand are very loud across the whole frame, so hero and background have equal chroma. There is little neutral color to rest the eye. The water is more photoreal than the real cards.
Hot pink, orange, purple and neon green all at full chroma. The green background is as loud as the coral, with no neutral rest. The purple rocks are the only muted area.
Blue gradient background with navy lamp and a small cyan, yellow and red accent. Well controlled chroma. The grey truss gives neutral relief. Close to the real cards.
Red cooler, sand, sea, sky and three colored cans, plus a ball and starfish. Too many hue families at high chroma with no resting area. The scene is busy and uniformly saturated.
